Andreea Prisăcariu (born 9 February 2000) is a Romanian professional tennis player. Prisăcariu has career-high WTA rankings of 304 in singles and 200 in doubles. She has won six singles titles and 10 doubles titles on the ITF Circuit . Prisăcariu won her biggest title at the 2021 Open Catalunya , in the doubles event partnering Valentina Ivakhnenko . [ 3 ] She made her WTA Tour main-draw debut as a wildcard entrant at the 2021 Transylvania Open , losing to Lesia Tsurenko in the first round.
